CR - 1. Temporary repairs were carried out on the hatch cover seal rubber and the surrounding structure of No.1F (S) to keep it weather-tight.
2. Before permanent repair, the containers were prohibited from being loaded on top of the No.1F cargo hold hatch cover.

NK - The following damage in way of No.1F(S) hatch cover shall be repaired to the satisfaction of the attending surveyor prior to crediting vessel's next Annual Survey, but not later than the due date below.
1. The internal structures in way of the forward, outboard stacking position were found deformed, buckled and twisted. 
2. Hatch cover top plating was found deformed between transverse beam Nos. T14 and T16, and between longitudinal beam Nos. L13 and L14. 
Above damage shall be subject to regular examination of ship crew for verification of progress of damage, and report to Class if any serious progress.

NK - The temporarily repaired No.1F (P/S) hatch covers is be permanent repaired but not later than the due date below, and subjected to following:
a. The affected cargo hold space is daily monitored and relevant entries should be recorded in the vessel's official log book.
b. A risk assessment is carried out as per Company's SMS procedure and appropriate control measures are implemented on board.
c. All the officers in charge of a navigational watch are aware of the said deficiency and of the measures implemented to compensate it.

CR - In way of No. 1F (S) Cargo Hold Hatch Cover
The internal structures in way of the forward, outboard stacking position were found deformed, buckled and twisted.
Hatch cover top plating was found deformed between transverse beam Nos. T14 and T16, and between longitudinal beam Nos. L13 and L14.
It is recommended that the above defective items be repaired and dealt with to the satisfaction of the attending surveyor prior to crediting vessel’s next Annual Survey, but not later than 24 June 2027.
